1. Authentication and Base URLs
The Enterprise Knowledge Assistant API is exposed internally over HTTPS. All requests require authentication via an
Okta-issued JSON Web Token (JWT) passed in the Authorization header:
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
Base URL: https://api.knowledge.internal.apextech.com/v1
2. Core Query Endpoint: POST /v1/query
Submits a natural language question against the enterprise knowledge base, returning a grounded response with source
citations.
Request Payload
POST /v1/query HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "query": "Can a new employee work remotely during the first week?",
  "collections": ["HR", "SECURITY"],
  "top_k": 3,
  "include_citations": true
}
